page.summary: Buy a short hook-timer pause when immediate rescue is unsafe, then use that time to arrange a real save.

verdict.recommendation: Use Reassurance only when a hooked teammate is under sustained pressure and the pause creates an actionable rescue window; it is not a substitute for unhooking.
verdict.soloQ: Check whether another rescuer can use the extra time before spending your own travel on a six-metre approach.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Call the pause and designate the next rescuer so the team does not wait through the timer without a plan.
verdict.mainWeakness: A six-metre activation route can be dangerous, and a pause is wasted if the Killer leaves or no teammate converts it into a rescue.

options.whyItsHere: Within six metres of a hooked Survivor, Active Ability pauses their Sacrifice Process for 20/25/30 seconds, once per Survivor per Hook Instance.

opening: Read hook stage, Killer pressure, your approach route and who will perform the eventual save.

rows.situation: The Killer controls the hook, immediate rescue risks a down, and you can safely reach six metres.
rows.action: Activate Reassurance and tell the next rescuer the pause is active. Use the extra 20/25/30 seconds to reposition or continue useful work, then take a real rescue window.
rows.why: The perk pauses the Sacrifice Process and, in Struggle Phase, Struggle Skill Checks; it does not free the hooked Survivor.

rows.situation: The Killer has left or a safe unhook is already available.
rows.action: Take or hand off the rescue now instead of detouring into Reassurance range.
rows.why: The module changes timing only when hook pressure makes immediate rescue worse.

rows.situation: The pause is running but the planned rescuer cannot reach or the Killer changes position.
rows.action: Reassign the save immediately; if no safe conversion exists, return to an objective and reassess before the hook stage advances.
rows.why: One use per Survivor per Hook Instance means the same user cannot simply repeat the pause on that hook.

abortWhen: Do not force a six-metre approach that exposes you to a down.
Stop waiting once the Killer leaves and a safe unhook is available.

strengths: Can preserve a hook stage long enough to coordinate a safer rescue.
weaknesses: Range, one-use-per-hook-instance limit and dependence on a subsequent rescue restrict value.
commonMistakes: Treating the timer pause as a rescue or as repeatable on the same Hook Instance.
Approaching a hook after the Killer has already left just to trigger the perk.
